```{r}
size_ <- 6
umap_plot <- DimPlot(BAL_macrophages )

umap_plot <- umap_plot$data %>% ggplot(aes(UMAP_1,UMAP_2,color=ident))+ geom_point(aes(alpha=0.2))+
  theme(legend.position = "none")  +theme_2 +  ggplot2::scale_color_manual(values = color.cluster)
umap_plot
markers_cluster_tbl <-  read_rds("../data/markers_cluster_tbl.rds")
manuallly_sel_2groups <- c("ITGAM", "CD14", "CCR1", "CSF1R","FABP4","INHBA","FFAR4",  "PPARG", "PCOLCE2")
top_markers_cluster <- markers_cluster_tbl %>% mutate(clus=factor(clus, levels = cluster_names))%>%group_by(clus) %>% slice_max(summary.AUC,n= 5)%>% arrange(.by_group = ) %>%  pull(gene) %>% unique()
dot_plot <- dot_plot_cluster(unique(c(manuallly_sel_2groups, top_markers_cluster)))+theme(legend.position = "none", axis.text.x = element_text(size_),axis.text.y = element_text(size_))
a1 <- umap_plot + dot_plot+plot_annotation(tag_levels = 'A') & 
  theme(plot.tag = element_text(size = 8))

a1
```

```{r warning=FALSE}
PC_1_lollypop <- BAL_macrophages@reductions$pca@feature.loadings.projected %>% as_tibble(rownames = "ensg") %>% mutate(gene=genifiy(ensg)) %>% select(gene,PC_1)  %>% mutate(pc_squared=((PC_1)^2)) %>% top_n(pc_squared, n=20) %>% select(-pc_squared) %>% mutate(up_down=if_else(PC_1<0,"negative", "positive"), gene= fct_reorder(gene,PC_1)) %>% arrange(PC_1) %>% ggplot(aes(PC_1, gene,color=PC_1)) + geom_point(size=4)+ geom_segment(aes(x=0,xend=PC_1, y=gene,yend=gene), size=1)+theme_bw() +
  scale_color_distiller(
      palette = "RdYlBu", direction = -1)+
  theme(legend.position = "none", axis.title = element_blank())

PC_2_lollypop <- BAL_macrophages@reductions$pca@feature.loadings.projected %>% as_tibble(rownames = "ensg") %>% mutate(gene=genifiy(ensg)) %>% select(gene,PC_2)  %>% mutate(pc_squared=((PC_2)^2)) %>% top_n(pc_squared, n=20) %>% select(-pc_squared) %>% mutate(up_down=if_else(PC_2<0,"negative", "positive"), gene= fct_reorder(gene,PC_2)) %>% arrange(PC_2) %>% ggplot(aes(PC_2, gene,color=PC_2)) + geom_point(size=4)+ geom_segment(aes(x=0,xend=PC_2, y=gene,yend=gene), size=1) +theme_bw() +
  scale_color_distiller(palette = "RdYlBu", direction = -1)+
  theme(legend.position = "none", axis.title = element_blank())

x <- PC_1_lollypop+
  PC_2_lollypop+
  wrap_elements(clust_dendro&  theme(text = element_text(size = size_), axis.text =element_text(size = size_) ))+
  plot_layout(guides = "collect", widths = c(1), heights = c(6))&  theme(text = element_text(size = size_), axis.text =element_text(size = size_) )
```

```{r}
###loadings without cell embedings
#PC2 laodings
genes_sel <- c("CD163", "LGMN", "LYZ")
dims_sel <- c(1:2)
dat <- BAL_macrophages@assays$RNA@data[ensemblizer(genes_sel),] %>% as.matrix() %>% t() %>%
  as_tibble(rownames = "cell")
colnames(dat) <- c("cell",genifiy(colnames(dat)))
dat <- BAL_macrophages@reductions$pca@cell.embeddings[,dims_sel] %>% as_tibble(rownames = "cell") %>% left_join(dat)


PC_2_top_loaded <- dat %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = CD163:LGMN, values_to = "value")%>%
  group_by(name) %>% mutate(scaled_value=scale(value)) %>% mutate(value=value*-1)  %>% 
  ggplot(aes(PC_2,value))+geom_smooth(aes(color=name))+coord_flip()+theme_2 + xlim(c(y_lim_pc_and_loadings))

### PC1 loadings

genes_sel <- c("APOC1",
               "S100A8")
dims_sel <- c(1:2)
dat <- BAL_macrophages@assays$RNA@data[ensemblizer(genes_sel),] %>% as.matrix() %>% t() %>% as_tibble(rownames = "cell")
meta_data_param <- "HLA_d"
genes_sel %<>% c(meta_data_param)
dat_meta <- BAL_macrophages[[meta_data_param]] %>% as_tibble(rownames = "cell")
colnames(dat) <- c("cell",genifiy(colnames(dat)))
dat %<>%  left_join(dat_meta)
dat <- BAL_macrophages@reductions$pca@cell.embeddings[,dims_sel] %>% as_tibble(rownames = "cell") %>% left_join(dat)


PC_1_top_loaded <- dat %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = S100A8:HLA_d, values_to = "value") %>%
  group_by(name) %>% mutate(scaled_value=scale(value))  %>% 
  ggplot(aes(PC_1,scaled_value))+geom_smooth(aes(color=name))+theme_2 + xlim(x_lim_pc_and_loadings)
```

```{r}
col_axis.genes <- function(x){
  dings_col <- ifelse(x$data$Gene%in% all_intersect,"red",
                    ifelse(x$data$Gene%in% common_genes, "green","black"))
  dings_col <- dings_col[1:length(unique(x$data$Gene))]
  return(list(theme(axis.text.y = element_text(color=dings_col), axis.text.x = element_text(color="black", size=size_))))
}
Reyf_MCluster1_lo_corr_dot_plot <- lo_corr_dot_plot_corr("Reyf_MCluster1_lo_corr")
```

```{r}
clean_hgnc <- . %>% ensemblizer_2() %>% genifiy_2() %>% discard(is.na)
s1 <- genesets_fibrosis$Reyf_MCluster1 %>% clean_hgnc
s2 <- genesets_fibrosis$`Mors_1SPP1+MIPF`%>% clean_hgnc
s3 <- genesets_fibrosis$Ayau_IPFeMp%>% clean_hgnc
all_intersect <- Reduce(intersect, list(s1,s2,s3 ))
common_genes <- c(
intersect(s1,s2),
intersect(s2,s3),
intersect(s1,s3)) %>% unique()
```
